verdict.rationale: Apify documents a scheduling feature that automatically starts Actors and saved tasks at specific times. Tasks persist reusable inputs for recurring runs, and webhooks can start another Actor when a run finishes or fails, so multi-step workflows can be chained. Missing for 10: in-depth scheduling docs (cron syntax, timezones), evidence that schedules can be created and managed programmatically via API/CLI/MCP for AI-native use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
